claim_traces.claim_title: Great Wall of China visible from space
claim_traces.claim_text: "The Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible from space with the naked eye."
reasoning_steps: The claim is a well-documented misconception

According to NASA and astronaut observations, the Great Wall of China is generally not visible to the naked human eye from low Earth orbit (such as from the International Space Station) without magnification or extreme optical enhancement
The wall is relatively narrow (averaging only 5 to 9 meters in width) and was built from local stone, clay, and soil, causing it to blend into the surrounding natural landscape
Furthermore, many other man-made structures—such as city lights at night, wide highways, large canals, bridges, and open-pit mines—are much more discernible from low Earth orbit than the Great Wall.
